autostart.description: Whether to automatically start the dlm_controld service on boot.

debug_level.description: Verbosity of debug logging. Higher numbers produce more log detail (0–7).

kernel_module.description: Path to the DLM kernel module. Leave default unless using a custom-built module.

lockspace_dir.description: Directory where user-space lockspaces store state files.

start_timeout.description: Seconds to wait for the kernel DLM module to load before failing.

threads.description: Number of worker threads to handle lock operations. Increase for high-lock-throughput workloads.

voting.description: Enable or disable voting protocol for cluster membership. Disable only for non-clustered deployments.

quorum_threshold.description: Minimum number of votes required for quorum. 0 uses cluster manager default.

log_file.description: Path to the DLM log file. Leave empty to log to syslog instead.

log_subsys.description: Logging destination: 'syslog' for system logs or 'file' for dedicated log file.

cluster_nodes.description: List of cluster nodes (for static configuration when cluster manager is not available).

name.description: Node name (must be resolvable via DNS or /etc/hosts).

addr.description: IP address used for DLM inter-node communication.

lockspace_config.description: Optional per-lockspace tuning. Each entry configures a named lockspace.

recovery_slot_timeout.description: Seconds to wait for a slot to be freed during recovery.

client_timeout.description: Seconds before marking a client connection dead.

fencing.description: Fencing configuration for cluster safety. Required in shared-disk clusters.

fence_timeout.description: Seconds to wait for fencing operation to complete before taking over as lock manager.

network.description: Network communication tuning for DLM inter-node protocol.

max_retries.description: Max retries for retransmitting network messages.

connect_timeout.description: Seconds to wait for a TCP connection to another node.
